original.statement: Automatic stream sharding is now enabled by default in Loki 3.0.0, balancing write load of high-volume streams across ingesters.

decision.reason: [ev-ed0515bb7146] says only that automatic stream sharding is now enabled by default in 3.0.0. It does not name the config key or its old value. So P1's config-key "automatic_stream_sharding.enabled" with default-changed false→true is not supported by the evidence. The free-form subject "automatic-stream-sharding" with behavior-changed (after "enabled by default") matches the text: with the same configuration, sharding now runs where it may not have before.
